headline: Finance Operations Specialist
summary: Dedicated finance professional with 4 years of experience in banking operations and financial data analysis. Proven track record in streamlining reconciliation processes and improving report accuracy within the Nepalese banking sector.

Automate monthly financial reporting using Excel macros, reducing manual processing time by 30%.

Supported the audit team during internal and external financial reviews.
